generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: A producer and an independent consumer can validate different structural subsets of the same certified evidence artifact, allowing a reduced object to pass the producer gate and fail only after handoff.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: Validate only pass status, subject identity and blocker list at publication while the independent consumer additionally requires a policy object or other canonical structural fields.
trigger_signals: certified evidence consumed by multiple skills
producer and auditor have separate validators
schema fields can be omitted without changing pass status
generalized_learning.reusable_control: CODE-GROWTH-SCHEMA-PARITY-001: validate one canonical evidence schema at production, terminal handoff and independent preflight, with negative cases for missing and wrong-typed required fields.
generalized_learning.prevention_rule: Evidence producers and terminal validators must validate the complete canonical schema before publishing a certified artifact; reduced remediation forms are rejected.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: Independent preflight must use a generated copy of the same canonical schema before semantic refutation, and contract tests must detect schema-copy drift.

transfer_cases.procedure: Remove a required nested object from a synthetic certified evidence report and validate producer plus terminal consumer.
transfer_cases.observed: Both validators reject the synthetic reduced report.

transfer_cases.procedure: Replace a required nested object with an incompatible type and validate terminal plus independent consumer.
transfer_cases.observed: Both validators reject the synthetic wrong-typed report.

skill_changes.evidence: Canonical schema plus terminal validator and generic negative contract tests are installed and passing.
Generated schema copy plus independent preflight validator and matching generic negative tests are installed and passing.
